Joseph Varner, III, who practices law in Tampa, Florida, was selected to Super Lawyers for 2006 - 2026. The Super Lawyers selection process takes into account peer recognition, professional achievement in legal practice, and other cogent factors.
Prior to becoming an attorney, he studied at University of Virginia School of Law. He graduated in 1983. After passing the bar exam, he was admitted to legal practice in 1983.
